description: Agent-native people API for evidence-backed people search, identity resolution, deep profiles, and contact enrichment.

api.description: Read the workspace ACU balance and API key budget state

fields.type: { plan?: string, acu?: { included: number, purchased: number, used: number, available: number, overage: number } }

api.description: Read workspace ACU usage plus the calling key id and active key count

fields.type: { credits?: { plan?: string, acu?: { included: number, purchased: number, used: number, available: number, overage: number } }, api_key?: { id?: string, active_keys?: number } }

api.description: Resolve contact fields (work_email 1, personal_email 3, phone 10 ACU per hit) from a person_id, LinkedIn URL, email, or name plus company domain

fields.type: { linkedin_url: string } | { person_id: string } | { email: string } | { name: string, company_domain: string }

{ work_email?: { value?: string | null, status: found | not_found | unavailable, confidence?: guess | strong | verified | null, source?: contact_network | linked_profile | public_code | public_web | null, last_seen?: string | null }, personal_email?: { value?: string | null, status: found | not_found | unavailable, confidence?: guess | strong | verified | null, source?: contact_network | linked_profile | public_code | public_web | null, last_seen?: string | null }, phone?: { value?: string | null, status: found | not_found | unavailable, confidence?: guess | strong | verified | null, source?: contact_network | linked_profile | public_code | public_web | null, last_seen?: string | null } }

api.description: Cancel a queued or running person research run

fields.type: { run_id: string, status: queued | running | cancelled, poll_url?: string }

api.description: Fetch a reviewed deep person profile (25 ACU first profile) or start a durable research run (202)

fields.type: { person_id: string } | { linkedin_url: string } | { name: string, company_domain: string }

output.type: { data: { run_id: string, status: queued | running | cancelled, poll_url?: string }, meta: { request_id: string } } | { data?: { person_id?: string, summary?: string | null, identity?: { name?: string, linkedin_url?: string | null, headline?: string | null, company?: string | null, location?: string | null, confidence?: number } | null } | null, meta: { request_id: string } }

api.description: Poll a person research run by id; returns run state or, once finished, the reviewed profile. 404 unknown, 410 expired

output.type: { data: { run_id: string, status: queued | running | cancelled, poll_url?: string }, meta: { request_id: string } } | { data?: { person_id?: string, summary?: string | null, identity?: { name?: string, linkedin_url?: string | null, headline?: string | null, company?: string | null, location?: string | null, confidence?: number } | null } | null, meta: { request_id: string } }

api.description: Identify one person from a name plus a clue and return the permanent person_id; 2 ACU when found, free when not

fields.type: { found: boolean, person?: { person_id: string, name: string, headline?: string | null, company?: string | null, location?: string | null, profiles?: { linkedin?: string, github?: string, x?: string }, identity_verified?: boolean } | null, confidence: number, summary?: string, sources?: string[] }

api.description: Find candidate identities in the people index for 1 ACU, including zero matches

fields.type: { matches: { person_id: string, name: string, title?: string | null, company?: string | null, location?: string | null, linkedin_url?: string | null, profile_url?: string | null }[], returned: number }

api.description: Search people by semantic query and hard filters; synchronous, at most 150 results

fields.type: { title?: string | { any_of?: string[], none_of?: string[] }, seniority?: string | { any_of?: string[], none_of?: string[] }, company?: string | { any_of?: string[], none_of?: string[], employee_count?: { gte?: number, lte?: number }, funding_stage?: { in: pre_seed | seed | series_a | series_b | series_c | series_d_plus | public | bootstrapped[] } }, industry?: string | { any_of?: string[], none_of?: string[] }, location?: string | { any_of?: string[], none_of?: string[], countries?: string[], cities?: string[] }, company_size?: { min?: number, max?: number }, experience?: { past_companies: { any_of: string[] } }, education?: { schools: { any_of: string[] } } }
{ fields?: linkedin | title | company | location | name[] }
